problem: Preserve and verify Frank v0.1 material semantics across source->compile->artifact->ProductStart->consume->effect->outcome->reentry->recovery without confusing semantic equivalence with byte identity or allowing green subsystem evidence to substitute for missing axes.

hypotheses.mechanism: Keep the new ProductStart AND-gate plus existing local guards; add no cross-stage primitive.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: cross-stage chimera/replay can satisfy local checks while violating shared lineage
hypotheses.counterprediction: mutation tests spanning two or more stages reveal escapes
hypotheses.falsifier: existing guards reject the complete LSCW mutation corpus and real target mutants with lower complexity
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: It increasingly does; this is the null baseline that must beat any new candidate.

hypotheses.mechanism: Consume one current typed semantic-conservation witness per material lifecycle transition and issue exactly one successor only after local refinement/conservation validation.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: ordinary CurrentExecutionContext plus local checks is equivalent
hypotheses.counterprediction: LSCW adds no mutant coverage or only adds overhead
hypotheses.falsifier: simpler context/guards match all valid/invalid decisions and target-live recovery cases
hypotheses.minimum_test: frozen mutation corpus + linear replay lesion
hypotheses.ancestry_family: typestate + capabilities + translation validation + proof-carrying data
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current contracts contain many axis-specific receipts but no single consume-and-reissue semantic conservation relation across the whole lifecycle.

hypotheses.mechanism: Hash-chain exact bytes from source through runtime and recovery.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: byte identity is too strict for allowed semantic-preserving transformations
hypotheses.falsifier: all required transitions can be pinned to exact bytes with no legitimate flexibility cost
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Artifact hashes exist, but exact byte identity cannot substitute for semantic preservation.

hypotheses.mechanism: Treat every lifecycle stage as a translator and validate a source/target refinement relation per concrete transition.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: runtime/effect/recovery are not compiler translations and include authority/state acquisition
hypotheses.counterprediction: refinement alone cannot prevent sibling/replay/chimera lineage
hypotheses.falsifier: translation checks need separate lineage and single-use machinery
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Compiler work is adding lowering/evaluator checks but not a general lifecycle refinement relation.

hypotheses.mechanism: Every transition carries a machine-checkable proof/certificate that output obeys policy and derives from valid inputs/history.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: proof generation complexity dominates Frank v0.1 and duplicates simpler typed receipts
hypotheses.falsifier: typed local checks provide same guarantees under matched threat model
hypotheses.minimum_test: certificate vs typed receipt mutant coverage and overhead
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Receipts are evidence objects but are not general proof-carrying derivations.

hypotheses.mechanism: Material transitions require an unforgeable or logically linear capability scoped to semantic epoch, state lineage, action class and generation.
hypotheses.expected_gain: monotonic non-escalating authority and single-use transitions
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: capability says who/what may act, not whether semantics were preserved
hypotheses.counterprediction: semantic drift survives with a valid capability
hypotheses.falsifier: authority-preserving but semantically wrong mutant passes
hypotheses.minimum_test: compiler semantic mutation under valid transition capability
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Execution generation is fenced, but not all lifecycle semantics are capability-scoped.

hypotheses.mechanism: Maintain separate semantic-equivalence root and exact product/artifact identity root; require stage-specific relations between them.
hypotheses.problem_target: confusion of semantic equivalence with exact identity
hypotheses.expected_gain: accept safe recompilation while preserving strict ProductStart identity
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: two roots increase ambiguity and synchronization risk
hypotheses.falsifier: one canonical root plus explicit metadata is simpler and equally discriminating
hypotheses.minimum_test: recompile, sibling binary, transplanted state, rollback
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current work has artifact and semantic roots but no universal typed cross-root conservation rule.

hypotheses.mechanism: Represent lifecycle lineage as a Merkle DAG with explicit causal parents and epoch joins rather than linear logs.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: DAG identity does not prove semantic correctness or authority
hypotheses.counterprediction: bad but correctly hashed transitions persist
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Lineage exists but current acceptance is not simply a Merkle-DAG semantics.

hypotheses.mechanism: Compile lifecycle states into a typestate machine: BUILT->ATTESTED->ADMITTED->STARTED->EFFECT_OPEN->OUTCOME_VERIFIED->REENTERED with only legal transitions.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: valid ordering can still carry wrong lineage/content
hypotheses.counterprediction: same typestate but wrong state root passes
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Lifecycle states exist but are not one global typestate automaton.

hypotheses.mechanism: Treat execution-generation/effect ownership as a resource transferred exactly once from planner/gate to provider/outcome/reentry.
hypotheses.problem_target: duplicate effects and causal credit ambiguity
hypotheses.expected_gain: local reasoning about who owns the right to advance
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: external provider may commit despite local ownership loss/timeout
hypotheses.counterprediction: unknown outcome still requires durable idempotent reconciliation
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Generation fencing approximates this for effects, not the complete lifecycle.

hypotheses.mechanism: Store only immutable material transitions and deterministically derive current state/witness from event reduction.
hypotheses.expected_gain: replayable provenance with fewer mutable heads
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: bad events remain bad and full reduction can be expensive
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: UnifiedDB is event/provenance rich but product state includes additional runtime authorities.

hypotheses.mechanism: Maintain equivalence classes of semantically interchangeable representations/artifacts and select cheapest accepted representative.
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: equivalence relation itself is hard to prove for effectful stateful systems
hypotheses.counterprediction: unsound rewrite merges non-equivalent authority behavior
hypotheses.falsifier: authority-sensitive counterexample in same proposed class
hypotheses.minimum_test: effect-policy preserving vs effect-policy dropping optimization

hypotheses.mechanism: Track a low-dimensional abstract semantic shadow of each concrete state and require monotone/conservative transfer across transitions.
hypotheses.counterprediction: different concrete actions map to same abstract shadow
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current typed fields are explicit rather than a unified abstract domain.

hypotheses.mechanism: Model every material semantic dimension as conserved flux through lifecycle boundaries; a stage declares only the dimensions it may transform, and any unexplained residual is a fail-closed defect.
hypotheses.expected_gain: turns many ad-hoc equality checks into one explicit conservation equation plus typed transform budget
hypotheses.strongest_countermechanism: the metaphor collapses to ordinary refinement checks once formalized
hypotheses.counterprediction: no additional discriminating power beyond generalized translation validation
hypotheses.falsifier: remove conservation vocabulary and implement identical relation with simpler typed pre/postconditions
hypotheses.minimum_test: same mutation corpus plus complexity/overhead comparison
hypotheses.why_current_architecture_does_not_alread: Current contracts enumerate invariants but do not expose a stage-local residual over a common semantic dimension basis.
